create_contacts_app: create a ContactsApp instance and register it with an Environment to manage contacts
add_contact: add a Contact object with name, gender, age, job, and contact details to the ContactsApp
get_contacts_with_pagination: retrieve contacts from the ContactsApp with optional offset and view limit for pagination
edit_contact: edit an existing contact by key with a dictionary of field updates including name and job
add_new_contact_with_strings: add a new contact using keyword string arguments that auto-validate Gender and Status enums
